{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts overshoot price by 0.1-0.3 on first days due to lagging behind rapid price adjustments",
    "True outcomes show more volatility than model forecasts, especially in first 10-day window",
    "Sentiment turning negative (value < 0) correlates with slower price declines in true outcomes",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (value ≥ 1.00), true prices support model forecasts better in early days",
    "Model underestimates price floor in bearish periods - true prices don't descend as far as forecasted",
    "Sentiment exhaustion (repeated 0.00 values) precedes period where sentiment no longer provides directional bias",
    "Price mean reversion is stronger in true outcomes than modeled, particularly 3-7 days after significant price moves"
] }
